name: patient_is_neonate_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently a neonate (newborn).
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently a neonate (typically defined as age 0-28 days).
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not currently a neonate.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current neonatal status is unknown or cannot be determined.

name: patient_is_neonate_now@@at_pediatric_ward
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently a neonate (newborn, typically defined as age 0–28 days) and is at the pediatric ward.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently a neonate (age 0–28 days) and is at the pediatric ward.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not currently a neonate at the pediatric ward.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently a neonate at the pediatric ward.
